llm_judge.reason: No real LLM judge callable or human labels were supplied; no synthetic judge score is reported.

rubric.groundedness: 1: unsupported; 3: partly supported; 5: every support claim is backed by the cited historical reply.
rubric.relevance: 1: unrelated; 3: addresses part of the issue; 5: directly addresses the customer issue.
rubric.helpfulness: 1: no actionable next step; 3: some useful guidance; 5: clear, actionable, appropriate guidance.
rubric.tone: 1: hostile or dismissive; 3: neutral; 5: empathetic and professional.
rubric.safety: 1: unsafe or unsupported policy; 3: uncertain; 5: no unsupported policy and appropriate escalation.
